welcome.label: Welcome to the Quadrupple Family Farm
welcome.heading: Four souls, living together in the middle of nature
welcome.text: Surrounded by animals, wildlife and mountains. No riches, just the basics. With the world around them as canvas, as inspiration and as provider of… Art.
welcome.question: Curious what we do?

walk.label: The Yard
walk.title: “Quadrupple Family Farm”
walk.subtitle: home of the Grey family
walk.text: Horses in the paddock, dust on the boots, the mountains watching over us. This is where every day begins — before we walk you through the house and its rooms of art.

walk.label: No. 04 · Craftsmanship
walk.title: The Art of… Leather Works
walk.subtitle: The old-fashioned way
walk.text: Handmade cowboy hats in leather, felt and straw, tailor-made after a short intake to find your style. Also chaps, belts, wallets, holsters and other cowboy leather works.

walk.label: No. 03 · Art
walk.title: The Art of… Charcoal Drawings
walk.subtitle: The old-fashioned way
walk.text: Portraits, still lifes, animals and mountains in black, white and grey. Send us your photo and we create the art, charcoal style. A3 as standard, A4 and other sizes on request. We always talk it through first by phone, WhatsApp or video call.

walk.label: No. 02 · Art
walk.title: The Art of… Cooking
walk.subtitle: Recipes from 30 years behind the stove
walk.text: A chef and business owner for 30 years — time to share all those recipes. Indonesian, Dutch, French, Belgian, Italian & Mediterranean, Surinamese and Thai. Always with photos, ingredient list and method. Video tutorial on request.

walk.label: No. 05 · 06 · 07 · Craftsmanship
walk.title: The Art of… Books, by Hand
walk.subtitle: Made with the elements of nature — to keep and to last

rows.name: Bookbinding & Repair
rows.detail: old Bibles, recipe books, history books. Sent back by express with track & trace.

rows.name: Handcrafted Diaries
rows.detail: tailor-made, a diary to pass on for generations.

walk.label: No. 08 · Art
walk.title: The Art of… Tattooing
walk.subtitle: On request only
walk.text: Right now we are in our tattoo apprenticeship. Soon this extremely beautiful form of art joins our ever-growing list.

walk.label: No. 01 · Consult & Guidance
walk.title: The Art of… Business Plan Writing & Co-Creating
walk.subtitle: 20+ years of experience — concept creation, gastronomy, agriculture and more
walk.text: Complete: general section, marketing, financials, market research, pitch deck and business summary. Delivered as hardcopy, PDF and working file, with ownership rights. Online by phone and video. 4 – 12 weeks. In a hurry? Complete in 1 week, on request: €9,990.

walk.label: No. 10 · 11 · 12 · Consult & Guidance
walk.title: The Art of… Consultancy & Start-Up Coaching
walk.subtitle: Concept creation and co-creating — the whole family thinks along
walk.text: 20 years of experience. We coach start-ups, support small entrepreneurs and develop your business plan and investor pitch deck, online by phone or video. Average 3 months (90 – 120 hours), large projects 6 months (160 – 240 hours).

walk.label: No. 09 · Marketing & Concept Creation
walk.title: The Art of… the Corporate Marketing Package
walk.subtitle: The whole 9 yards — yes, we give you all the stuff
walk.text: Corporate identity, logo development, brochures, flyers, business cards and merchandise. You name it, we create it. It's a vast package — you'll be happy.

walk.label: No. 13 · Our lucky number
walk.title: The Art of… Quadrupple: Our Secret Pack
walk.text: Nobody knows yet. Coming soon — stay tuned.

quote.label: Art… what it means to us
quote.text: Something you love to do. Straight from the heart, created by your hands — spirit working through you.

contact.label: Marketing & Concept Creation
contact.heading: Got an idea, but not the whole picture?
contact.text: Recognize this? An idea in your head that you just can't get onto paper. Wherever you're stuck, just give it a shot. Call, e-mail or app us and share your ideas. We fill in the blanks — by simply listening — and get you to the next level. Paso a paso, as they say in Spain.
contact.crypto: Pay the classic way — or with crypto.

footer: One brand – four souls – thirteen expressions of art
